_readme: WHY THIS FILE IS NEARLY EMPTY, AND WHY THAT IS CORRECT.
Almost every service reset is manufacturer-specific: the same oil-life
reset is a different routine identifier on a Honda than on a BMW, and on
some makes it differs between model years. Those identifiers are not
published, and they CANNOT be discovered the way data identifiers can.
Sweeping service 0x22 to find readable values is safe -- an identifier
that does not exist answers 'requestOutOfRange' and nothing happens.
Sweeping service 0x31 to find routines would not be safe at all. A routine
is a procedure a module RUNS: the number you just guessed might spin a
cooling fan, cycle an ABS pump, retract a parking brake, or run the engine
to a target speed. There is no harmless miss.
So this file ships only what is verified, and OmaCar says 'no verified
resets for this vehicle' rather than offering a guess. An invented routine
identifier presented as a button is the single most dangerous thing this
TO CONTRIBUTE ONE: see doc/RESETS.md. A definition needs a source (a
service manual, an OEM procedure, or a verified capture), the vehicles it
was confirmed on, and someone willing to say it worked on their own car.

schema.name: what a person calls it
schema.makes: list of makes it applies to; omit or empty for universal
schema.models: optional list of specific models, when it is narrower than a make
schema.confirmed_on: list of vehicles somebody actually ran it on
schema.warning: what happens when it runs, shown before the button
schema.preconditions: list of things that must be true first

resets.name: Clear emissions codes
resets.source: SAE J1979 mode 04 — standardised on every OBD-II vehicle since 1996
resets.warning: Erases emissions fault codes and freeze-frame data, and resets every readiness monitor to 'not complete'. The car will fail an emissions test until the monitors run again, which usually takes several days of mixed driving. If the fault is still present the code returns immediately.
preconditions: Fix the fault first — clearing does not repair anything
Write down the codes before clearing; the freeze frame goes with them

resets.name: Clear one module's codes
resets.source: ISO 14229 service 0x14, ClearDiagnosticInformation, group FFFFFF (all groups)
resets.warning: Clears the manufacturer-specific codes held by one module — including faults that a generic mode-04 clear never touches. Choose the module before running it.
preconditions: A module address must be chosen
